The Waybler app is a tool for handling charging of electric cars and plug-in-hybrids. The app simplifies charging and provides an overview for daily usages.

Characteristics:  
* Function as a dashboard for starting and monitoring electrical charging 
* Applicable for all electric vehicle and plug in hybrids
* Payment service for actual usages 

The app provides following information: 
* Which parking space to choose 
* Charging status 
* Electrical usage 
* Push notifications about changes 
* Termination of charging 
* Arrival time
* Cost of charging
* Statistics  

Waybler enables people to charge their electric car at the same time – to the lowest possible cost. Wayblers vision is to enable a growing electrical car fleet by offering cost efficient charging!
